records.statement:
theorem exists_global_solution {lam r u gamma target : ℝ} {b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma)
    (z₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u z₀.1 z₀.2) :
    ∃ z : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, z 0 = z₀ ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivAt z (vectorField lam r u gamma target b (z t)) t) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → target ≤ E lam r u (z t).1 (z t).2 ∧
        E lam r u (z t).1 (z t).2 ≤ E lam r u z₀.1 z₀.2)
records.proof:
by
  let K : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {z | target ≤ E lam r u z.1 z.2 ∧
    E lam r u z.1 z.2 ≤ E lam r u z₀.1 z₀.2}
  have hK : IsCompact K :=
    LinearInputCoercivity.isCompact_band hlam r u target (E lam r u z₀.1 z₀.2)
  have hstart : z₀ ∈ K := ⟨hinit, le_refl _⟩
  have hF : ContDiff ℝ 1 (vectorField lam r u gamma target b) :=
    contDiff_vectorField hb lam r u gamma target
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hlocal⟩ := LinearInputCompactLocalExistence.exists_uniform_local_time hF hK
  have hstay : ∀ (a : ℝ) (z : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ), z 0 = z₀ →
      (∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) a,
        HasDerivAt z (vectorField lam r u gamma target b (z t)) t) →
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < a → z t ∈ K := by
    intro a z hz₀ hz t ht hta
    have hi : target ≤ E lam r u (z 0).1 (z 0).2 := by simpa only [hz₀] using hinit
    have he := LinearInputFiniteBand.energy_band_on_Ioo hgamma hε hz hi ht hta
    simpa only [K, mem_ofPred_eq, hz₀] using he
  obtain ⟨z, hz₀, hz⟩ :=
    LinearInputGlobalContinuation.exists_forward_solution hF hstart hε hlocal hstay
  refine ⟨z, hz₀, hz, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  have hi : target ≤ E lam r u (z 0).1 (z 0).2 := by simpa only [hz₀] using hinit
  have he := LinearInputFiniteBand.energy_band_on_Icc hgamma ht
    (fun s hs => hz s hs.1) hi (show t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) t from ⟨ht, le_refl t⟩)
  simpa only [hz₀] using he
records.comment:
Every initial state above the target has an actual forward-global solution.
The compact band and the required uniform continuation time are derived.

records.statement:
theorem exists_global_coordinate_trajectory {lam r u gamma target : ℝ} {b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma)
    (x₀ y₀ : ℝ) (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u x₀ y₀) :
    ∃ x y : ℝ → ℝ, x 0 = x₀ ∧ y 0 = y₀ ∧
      IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y (fun t => b (x t, y t)) ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → target ≤ E lam r u (x t) (y t) ∧
        E lam r u (x t) (y t) ≤ E lam r u x₀ y₀
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨z, hz₀, hz, hband⟩ := exists_global_solution hb hlam hgamma (x₀, y₀) hinit
  refine ⟨fun t => (z t).1, fun t => (z t).2,
    congrArg Prod.fst hz₀, congrArg Prod.snd hz₀, ?_, hband⟩
  exact isTrajectory_of_global_solution hz
records.comment: The existing coordinate trajectory predicate now has actual global inhabitants.

records.statement:
theorem exists_global_solution_one_add_sq {lam r u gamma target : ℝ}
    {Q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hQ : ContDiff ℝ 1 Q) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma)
    (z₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u z₀.1 z₀.2) :
    ∃ z : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, z 0 = z₀ ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        HasDerivAt z (vectorField lam r u gamma target (fun q => 1 + Q q ^ 2) (z t)) t) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → target ≤ E lam r u (z t).1 (z t).2 ∧
        E lam r u (z t).1 (z t).2 ≤ E lam r u z₀.1 z₀.2)
records.proof: exists_global_solution (contDiff_const.add (hQ.pow 2)) hlam hgamma z₀ hinit
records.comment: The original positive tangential coefficient admits actual forward-global solutions.

records.statement:
theorem solution_unique_on_Icc {F : V → V} {a c : ℝ}
    {z w : ℝ → V} (hF : ContDiff ℝ 1 F)
    (hz : ∀ t ∈ Icc a c, HasDerivAt z (F (z t)) t)
    (hw : ∀ t ∈ Icc a c, HasDerivAt w (F (w t)) t)
    (heq : z a = w a) : EqOn z w (Icc a c)
records.proof:
by
  have hzc : ContinuousOn z (Icc a c) :=
    fun t ht => (hz t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hwc : ContinuousOn w (Icc a c) :=
    fun t ht => (hw t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  let K : Set V := z '' Icc a c ∪ w '' Icc a c
  have hK : IsCompact K :=
    (isCompact_Icc.image_of_continuousOn hzc).union
      (isCompact_Icc.image_of_continuousOn hwc)
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := LocallyLipschitzOn.exists_lipschitzOnWith_of_compact hK
    hF.locallyLipschitz.locallyLipschitzOn
  apply ODE_solution_unique_of_mem_Icc_right (v := fun _ => F) (s := fun _ => K)
    (K := L) (fun _ _ => hL) hzc
    (fun t ht => (hz t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩).hasDerivWithinAt) ?_ hwc
    (fun t ht => (hw t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩).hasDerivWithinAt) ?_ heq
  · intro t ht
    exact Or.inl ⟨t, ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩, rfl⟩
  · intro t ht
    exact Or.inr ⟨t, ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩, rfl⟩
records.comment:
Two actual solutions of a C¹ vector field with the same initial value
agree on a closed time interval.  Their own compact images supply the common
Lipschitz set; neither an energy band nor a global Lipschitz bound is assumed.

records.statement:
theorem solution_unique_on_Ici {F : V → V} {a : ℝ}
    {z w : ℝ → V} (hF : ContDiff ℝ 1 F)
    (hz : ∀ t ∈ Ici a, HasDerivAt z (F (z t)) t)
    (hw : ∀ t ∈ Ici a, HasDerivAt w (F (w t)) t)
    (heq : z a = w a) : EqOn z w (Ici a)
records.proof:
by
  intro t ht
  exact solution_unique_on_Icc hF
    (fun s hs => hz s hs.1) (fun s hs => hw s hs.1) heq ⟨ht, le_refl t⟩
records.comment:
The finite-interval uniqueness theorem gives uniqueness on a forward
half-line.  No assumptions are made about the negative-time extensions.

records.statement:
theorem feedback_solution_unique_on_Icc {b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b) {lam r u gamma target a c : ℝ} {z w : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ}
    (hz : ∀ t ∈ Icc a c,
      HasDerivAt z (vectorField lam r u gamma target b (z t)) t)
    (hw : ∀ t ∈ Icc a c,
      HasDerivAt w (vectorField lam r u gamma target b (w t)) t)
    (heq : z a = w a) : EqOn z w (Icc a c)
records.proof: solution_unique_on_Icc (contDiff_vectorField hb lam r u gamma target) hz hw heq
records.comment:
The feedback vector solutions are unique on every finite forward interval,
for every real parameter choice and every C¹ autonomous tangential coefficient.

records.statement:
theorem feedback_solution_unique_on_Ici {b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b) {lam r u gamma target : ℝ} {z w : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ}
    (hz : ∀ t ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt z (vectorField lam r u gamma target b (z t)) t)
    (hw : ∀ t ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt w (vectorField lam r u gamma target b (w t)) t)
    (heq : z 0 = w 0) : EqOn z w (Ici (0 : ℝ))
records.proof: solution_unique_on_Ici (contDiff_vectorField hb lam r u gamma target) hz hw heq
records.comment:
Supplied feedback vector solutions with the same initial state agree for
all nonnegative times.  Existence remains a separate assertion.

records.proof:
by
  have heq : EqOn (fun t => (x₁ t, y₁ t)) (fun t => (x₂ t, y₂ t)) (Ici (0 : ℝ)) :=
    feedback_solution_unique_on_Ici hb
      (fun t ht => hasDerivAt_vectorField_iff.mpr (h₁ t ht))
      (fun t ht => hasDerivAt_vectorField_iff.mpr (h₂ t ht)) (Prod.ext hx hy)
  exact ⟨fun _ ht => congrArg Prod.fst (heq ht),
    fun _ ht => congrArg Prod.snd (heq ht)⟩
records.comment:
The same uniqueness statement in the original coordinate trajectory
predicate.  Both curves use the same state-dependent coefficient b.

records.statement:
theorem exists_global_convergent_solution {lam r u gamma target : ℝ}
    {b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b)
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 < gamma)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    (z₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u z₀.1 z₀.2) :
    ∃ z : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, z 0 = z₀ ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivAt z (vectorField lam r u gamma target b (z t)) t) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        0 ≤ E lam r u (z t).1 (z t).2 - target ∧
        E lam r u (z t).1 (z t).2 - target ≤
          (E lam r u z₀.1 z₀.2 - target) * Real.exp
            (-(gamma * gradientLowerBound lam r u target (E lam r u z₀.1 z₀.2)) * t)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun t => E lam r u (z t).1 (z t).2) atTop (𝓝 target)
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨z, hz₀, hz, _⟩ := LinearInputGlobalTrajectory.exists_global_solution
    hb hlam hgamma.le z₀ hinit
  have htraj := isTrajectory_of_global_solution hz
  have hi : target ≤ E lam r u (z 0).1 (z 0).2 := by simpa only [hz₀] using hinit
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hlimit⟩ := LinearInputInvariance.energy_convergence_of_initial
    hlam hgamma htarget htraj hi
  refine ⟨z, hz₀, hz, ?_, hlimit⟩
  intro t ht
  simpa only [hz₀] using energy_error_exponential_of_initial
    hlam hgamma.le htarget htraj hi ht
records.comment: Actual global existence and the explicit convergence bound in one theorem.

records.statement:
theorem exists_global_injective_convergent_solution {lam r u gamma target : ℝ}
    {b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b)
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 < gamma)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    (z₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (hinit : target < E lam r u z₀.1 z₀.2) :
    ∃ z : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, z 0 = z₀ ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivAt z (vectorField lam r u gamma target b (z t)) t) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → target < E lam r u (z t).1 (z t).2) ∧
      StrictAntiOn (fun t => E lam r u (z t).1 (z t).2) (Ici (0 : ℝ)) ∧
      InjOn z (Ici (0 : ℝ)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun t => E lam r u (z t).1 (z t).2) atTop (𝓝 target)
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨z, hz₀, hz, _, hlimit⟩ := exists_global_convergent_solution
    hb hlam hgamma htarget z₀ hinit.le
  have htraj := isTrajectory_of_global_solution hz
  have hi : target < E lam r u (z 0).1 (z 0).2 := by simpa only [hz₀] using hinit
  refine ⟨z, hz₀, hz, ?_,
    LinearInputStrictEnergy.energy_strictAntiOn hlam hgamma htarget htraj hi,
    ?_, hlimit⟩
  · intro t ht
    exact LinearInputStrictEnergy.energy_strictly_above_target htraj hi ht
  · simpa only [Prod.eta] using
      LinearInputStrictEnergy.trajectory_injOn hlam hgamma htarget htraj hi
records.comment: Above the target, the constructed convergent global solution is injective in time.

records.statement:
theorem radial_gradient_lower_bound {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (r u x y : ℝ) :
    E lam r u x y - (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) ≤
      x * gx lam r u x y + y * gy x y
records.proof:
by
  have hi := energy_gradient_identity lam r u x y
  have hb := reduced_energy_bound hlam r x
  have hy : y * gy x y = Real.sqrt 2 * x * gy x y + (gy x y) ^ 2 := by
    unfold gy
    ring
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (gy x y)]

records.statement:
theorem radial_gradient_pos {lam r u x y : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (he : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < E lam r u x y) :
    0 < x * gx lam r u x y + y * gy x y
records.proof:
by
  linarith [radial_gradient_lower_bound hlam r u x y]

records.statement:
theorem quadratic_remainder_bound {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (r : ℝ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    -3 * lam * q ^ 2 / 4 - r * q / 2 ≤ (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam)
records.proof:
by
  have h := reduced_energy_bound hlam r (Real.sqrt q)
  have h4 : (Real.sqrt q) ^ 4 = q ^ 2 := by
    rw [show (Real.sqrt q) ^ 4 = ((Real.sqrt q) ^ 2) ^ 2 by ring, Real.sq_sqrt hq]
  simpa only [h4, Real.sq_sqrt hq] using h

records.statement:
theorem energy_outward_scaling {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (r u x y : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    t * (E lam r u x y - (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam)) ≤
      E lam r u (t * x) (t * y) - (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam)
records.proof:
by
  let B := (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam)
  have hb := quadratic_remainder_bound hlam r (q := t * x ^ 2) (by positivity)
  have hi : E lam r u (t*x) (t*y) - B - t * (E lam r u x y - B) =
      (t - 1) * (B + 3 * lam * (t * x ^ 2) ^ 2 / 4 + r * (t * x ^ 2) / 2 +
        lam * t * (t - 1) ^ 2 * x ^ 4 / 4 + t * (y - Real.sqrt 2 * x) ^ 2 / 2) := by
    unfold E f
    ring
  have hn : 0 ≤ B + 3 * lam * (t * x ^ 2) ^ 2 / 4 + r * (t * x ^ 2) / 2 := by
    change -3 * lam * (t * x ^ 2) ^ 2 / 4 - r * (t * x ^ 2) / 2 ≤ B at hb
    linarith
  have hp : 0 ≤ lam * t * (t - 1) ^ 2 * x ^ 4 / 4 + t * (y - Real.sqrt 2 * x) ^ 2 / 2 := by
    positivity
  have hm := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht) (add_nonneg hn hp)
  change t * (E lam r u x y - B) ≤ E lam r u (t*x) (t*y) - B
  linarith
records.comment: Outside the critical-value threshold, outward dilation strictly raises energy.

records.statement:
theorem energy_outward_strict {lam r u x y t : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (he : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < E lam r u x y) (ht : 1 < t) :
    E lam r u x y < E lam r u (t*x) (t*y)
records.proof:
by
  have hs := energy_outward_scaling hlam r u x y (le_of_lt ht)
  have hp := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr ht) (sub_pos.mpr he)
  nlinarith

records.statement:
theorem existsUnique_positive_radius {lam r u e x y : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (he : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < e) (hz : x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0) :
    ∃! t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ E lam r u (t*x) (t*y) = e
records.proof:
by
  have hB : 0 ≤ (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) := by positivity
  have he0 : 0 < e := lt_of_le_of_lt hB he
  let q := x ^ 2 + (y - Real.sqrt 2 * x) ^ 2 / 2
  have hq : 0 < q := by
    dsimp [q]
    rcases hz with hx | hy
    · nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hx, sq_nonneg (y - Real.sqrt 2 * x)]
    · by_cases hx : x = 0
      · have hysq := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hy
        simpa [hx] using (div_pos hysq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2))
      · nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hx, sq_nonneg (y - Real.sqrt 2 * x)]
  let T := Real.sqrt ((max (e + lowerBoundConstant lam r u) 0 + 1) / q)
  have hT : 0 < T := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos (by positivity) hq)
  have hTsq : T ^ 2 * q = max (e + lowerBoundConstant lam r u) 0 + 1 := by
    dsimp [T]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    field_simp
  have hout : e < E lam r u (T*x) (T*y) := by
    have hc := coercive_lower_bound hlam r u (T*x) (T*y)
    have hi : (T*x)^2 + (T*y - Real.sqrt 2*(T*x))^2/2 = T^2*q := by dsimp [q]; ring
    rw [hi, hTsq] at hc
    have hm := le_max_left (e + lowerBoundConstant lam r u) 0
    linarith
  have hcont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => E lam r u (t*x) (t*y)) := by unfold E f; fun_prop
  have hzE : E lam r u (0*x) (0*y) = 0 := by simp [E, f]
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hte⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (le_of_lt hT) hcont.continuousOn
    (show e ∈ Set.Icc (E lam r u (0*x) (0*y)) (E lam r u (T*x) (T*y)) by
      rw [hzE]; exact ⟨le_of_lt he0, le_of_lt hout⟩)
  change E lam r u (t*x) (t*y) = e at hte
  have htpos : 0 < t := by
    have htne : t ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, hzE] at hte; linarith
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne ht.1 (Ne.symm htne)
  refine ⟨t, ⟨htpos, hte⟩, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  rcases lt_trichotomy a t with hat | hat | hat
  · have hratio : 1 < t / a := (lt_div_iff₀ ha.1).2 (by simpa using hat)
    have hh := energy_outward_strict hlam (by rwa [ha.2]) hratio
    have hx : (t/a)*(a*x) = t*x := by field_simp [ne_of_gt ha.1]
    have hy : (t/a)*(a*y) = t*y := by field_simp [ne_of_gt ha.1]
    rw [hx, hy, ha.2, hte] at hh
    exact (lt_irrefl e hh).elim
  · exact hat
  · have hratio : 1 < a / t := (lt_div_iff₀ htpos).2 (by simpa using hat)
    have hh := energy_outward_strict hlam (by rwa [hte]) hratio
    have hx : (a/t)*(t*x) = a*x := by field_simp [ne_of_gt htpos]
    have hy : (a/t)*(t*y) = a*y := by field_simp [ne_of_gt htpos]
    rw [hx, hy, ha.2, hte] at hh
    exact (lt_irrefl e hh).elim
records.comment: Each nonzero ray meets each energy level above the threshold exactly once.

records.statement: theorem radius_pos {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : z.1 ≠ 0 ∨ z.2 ≠ 0) : 0 < radius z
records.proof:
by
  apply Real.sqrt_pos.2
  rcases hz with h | h
  · nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero h, sq_nonneg z.2]
  · nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero h, sq_nonneg z.1]

records.statement:
theorem radius_pos_of_energy {lam r u : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) {z : ℝ × ℝ}
    (he : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < E lam r u z.1 z.2) : 0 < radius z
records.proof:
by
  apply radius_pos
  by_contra hz
  push Not at hz
  have hB : 0 ≤ (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) := by positivity
  simp [hz.1, hz.2, E, f] at he
  linarith

records.statement:
theorem direction_mem_circle {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : 0 < radius z) :
    (direction z).1 ^ 2 + (direction z).2 ^ 2 = 1
records.proof:
by
  have hs : radius z ^ 2 = z.1 ^ 2 + z.2 ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  dsimp [direction]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hz]
  exact hs.symm

records.statement:
theorem radius_mul_direction {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : 0 < radius z) :
    (radius z * (direction z).1, radius z * (direction z).2) = z
records.proof:
by
  apply Prod.ext <;> dsimp [direction] <;> field_simp [ne_of_gt hz]

records.statement:
theorem direction_positive_scale (z : ℝ × ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    direction (t*z.1, t*z.2) = direction z
records.proof:
by
  have hr : radius (t*z.1, t*z.2) = t * radius z := by
    dsimp [radius]
    rw [show (t*z.1)^2+(t*z.2)^2 = t^2*(z.1^2+z.2^2) by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg t), Real.sqrt_sq (le_of_lt ht)]
  apply Prod.ext <;> dsimp only [direction, Prod.fst, Prod.snd] <;>
    rw [hr] <;> exact mul_div_mul_left _ _ (ne_of_gt ht)

records.statement:
theorem direction_of_circle {v : ℝ × ℝ} (hv : v.1 ^ 2 + v.2 ^ 2 = 1) :
    direction v = v
records.proof:
by
  simp [direction, radius, hv]

records.statement: theorem continuous_radius : Continuous radius
records.proof: by unfold radius; fun_prop

records.statement:
theorem continuous_direction_subtype {S : Set (ℝ × ℝ)}
    (hS : ∀ z : S, 0 < radius z.val) : Continuous (fun z : S => direction z.val)
records.proof:
by
  apply Continuous.prodMk
  · exact (continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val).div
      (continuous_radius.comp continuous_subtype_val) (fun z => ne_of_gt (hS z))
  · exact (continuous_snd.comp continuous_subtype_val).div
      (continuous_radius.comp continuous_subtype_val) (fun z => ne_of_gt (hS z))

records.statement:
theorem eq_of_direction_energy_eq {lam r u : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) {z w : ℝ × ℝ}
    (he : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < E lam r u z.1 z.2)
    (hd : direction z = direction w) (hE : E lam r u z.1 z.2 = E lam r u w.1 w.2) :
    z = w
records.proof:
by
  have hz := radius_pos_of_energy hlam he
  have hw := radius_pos_of_energy hlam (he.trans_eq hE)
  have hx : z.1 * radius w = w.1 * radius z :=
    (div_eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hz) (ne_of_gt hw)).1 (congrArg Prod.fst hd)
  have hy : z.2 * radius w = w.2 * radius z :=
    (div_eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hz) (ne_of_gt hw)).1 (congrArg Prod.snd hd)
  have hscaleW : (radius w / radius z * z.1, radius w / radius z * z.2) = w := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · dsimp only
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
      apply (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hz)).2
      nlinarith
    · dsimp only
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
      apply (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hz)).2
      nlinarith
  have hscaleZ : (radius z / radius w * w.1, radius z / radius w * w.2) = z := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · dsimp only
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
      apply (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hw)).2
      nlinarith
    · dsimp only
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
      apply (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hw)).2
      nlinarith
  rcases lt_trichotomy (radius z) (radius w) with hlt | heq | hlt
  · have hs := energy_outward_strict hlam he
      ((lt_div_iff₀ hz).2 (by simpa using hlt))
    have hws := congrArg (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => E lam r u q.1 q.2) hscaleW
    change E lam r u (radius w / radius z * z.1) (radius w / radius z * z.2) =
      E lam r u w.1 w.2 at hws
    linarith
  · apply Prod.ext
    · exact (mul_right_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hw)) (by simpa only [heq] using hx)
    · exact (mul_right_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hw)) (by simpa only [heq] using hy)
  · have hs := energy_outward_strict hlam (he.trans_eq hE)
      ((lt_div_iff₀ hw).2 (by simpa using hlt))
    have hzs := congrArg (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => E lam r u q.1 q.2) hscaleZ
    change E lam r u (radius z / radius w * w.1) (radius z / radius w * w.2) =
      E lam r u z.1 z.2 at hzs
    linarith
records.comment: Direction and energy determine a point uniquely above the threshold.

records.statement:
theorem exponential_bound_on_Icc {v q : ℝ → ℝ} {k T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, HasDerivAt v (q t) t)
    (hi : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, q t ≤ -k * v t)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :
    v t ≤ v 0 * Real.exp (-k * t)
records.proof:
by
  let w : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.exp (k * s) * v s
  let dw : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.exp (k * s) * (k * v s + q s)
  have hw : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, HasDerivAt w (dw s) s := by
    intro s hs
    convert (((hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul k).exp.mul (hd s hs)) using 1
    · rfl
    · dsimp [dw]
      ring
  have hc : ContinuousOn w (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
    fun s hs => (hw s hs).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have ha : AntitoneOn w (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
    antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (convex_Icc (0 : ℝ) T) hc
      (fun s hs => (hw s (interior_subset hs)).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun s hs => by
        dsimp [dw]
        apply mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le
        have h := hi s (interior_subset hs)
        linarith)
  have hvalue : Real.exp (k * t) * v t ≤ v 0 := by
    simpa [w] using ha ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩ ht ht.1
  have hdiv : v t ≤ v 0 / Real.exp (k * t) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos _)).2
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hvalue
  simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.exp_neg, neg_mul] using hdiv
records.comment: Integrating-factor estimate requiring the differential inequality only on [0,T].

records.statement:
theorem square_bound_on_Icc {θ f : ℝ → ℝ} {κ ρ M T : ℝ}
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, HasDerivAt θ (-κ * θ t + ρ * f t) t)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, |f t| ≤ M)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :
    (θ t)^2 ≤ (θ 0)^2 * exp (-κ*t) + (ρ*M/κ)^2 * (1-exp (-κ*t))
records.proof:
by
  let C : ℝ := (ρ*M/κ)^2
  have hC : κ^2 * C = ρ^2 * M^2 := by
    dsimp [C]
    field_simp
  have hv : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
      HasDerivAt (fun s => (θ s)^2-C) (2*θ s*(-κ*θ s+ρ*f s)) s := by
    intro s hs
    convert ((hd s hs).pow 2).sub_const C using 1; ring
  have hi : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
      2*θ s*(-κ*θ s+ρ*f s) ≤ -κ*((θ s)^2-C) := by
    intro s hs
    have hf2 : (f s)^2 ≤ M^2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_abs (f s), hf s hs, abs_nonneg (f s)]
    have hforce : ρ^2*(f s)^2 ≤ ρ^2*M^2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf2 (sq_nonneg ρ)
    have hscaled : κ*(2*θ s*(-κ*θ s+ρ*f s)+κ*((θ s)^2-C)) ≤ 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (κ*θ s-ρ*f s)]
    have hsum : 2*θ s*(-κ*θ s+ρ*f s)+κ*((θ s)^2-C) ≤ 0 := by
      nlinarith
    linarith
  have hb := exponential_bound_on_Icc hT hv hi ht
  dsimp [C] at *
  nlinarith
records.comment: The explicit square bound is valid on every finite interval of existence.

records.statement:
theorem abs_le_on_Icc {θ f : ℝ → ℝ} {κ M T : ℝ}
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, HasDerivAt θ (-κ * θ t + f t) t)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, |f t| ≤ κ * M)
    (hinit : |θ 0| ≤ M) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) : |θ t| ≤ M
records.proof:
by
  have hb := square_bound_on_Icc (ρ := 1) hκ (mul_nonneg hκ.le hM) hT
    (fun s hs => by simpa only [one_mul] using hd s hs) hf ht
  have hc : (1 * (κ*M) / κ)^2 = M^2 := by field_simp
  rw [hc] at hb
  have hstart : (θ 0)^2 ≤ M^2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_abs (θ 0), abs_nonneg (θ 0)]
  have hprod := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (sub_nonpos.mpr hstart)
    (exp_pos (-κ*t)).le
  have ht2 : (θ t)^2 ≤ M^2 := by nlinarith
  nlinarith [sq_abs (θ t), abs_nonneg (θ t)]
records.comment: A forcing below κM preserves the interval [-M,M] for the damped coordinate.

theorem energy_band_on_Icc {n : ℕ} {lam r u gamma target T : ℝ}
    {b : State n → ℝ} {kappa rho : Fin n → ℝ} {Phi : ℝ × ℝ → (Fin n → ℝ)}

records.statement:
theorem exists_internal_bounds {n : ℕ} {K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {Phi : ℝ × ℝ → (Fin n → ℝ)} (hPhi : Continuous Phi)
    (kappa rho theta₀ : Fin n → ℝ) (hkappa : ∀ i, 0 < kappa i) :
    ∃ M : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ M i) ∧ (∀ i, |theta₀ i| ≤ M i) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ K, ∀ i, |rho i * Phi z i| ≤ kappa i * M i
records.proof:
by
  have hbounded (i : Fin n) : ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ K, |rho i * Phi z i| ≤ B := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Pi.mul_apply, Function.comp_def] using hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      ((continuous_const.mul ((continuous_apply i).comp hPhi)).continuousOn)
  choose B hB using hbounded
  let M : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => max |theta₀ i| (max (B i) 0 / kappa i)
  refine ⟨M, fun i => (abs_nonneg _).trans (le_max_left _ _),
    fun i => le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro z hz i
  have hM : max (B i) 0 ≤ kappa i * M i := by
    have hm : max (B i) 0 / kappa i ≤ M i := le_max_right _ _
    have hh := (div_le_iff₀ (hkappa i)).mp hm
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hh
  exact (hB i z hz).trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans hM)
records.comment:
A compact spatial set supplies finite coordinate bounds compatible with
strictly positive damping and every initial internal state.

records.statement:
theorem band_box_on_Icc {n : ℕ} {lam r u gamma target T : ℝ}
    {b : State n → ℝ} {kappa rho M : Fin n → ℝ} {Phi : ℝ × ℝ → (Fin n → ℝ)}
    {q : ℝ → State n} (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hkappa : ∀ i, 0 < kappa i) (hM : ∀ i, 0 ≤ M i)
    (hforce : ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ,
      target ≤ E lam r u z.1 z.2 ∧ E lam r u z.1 z.2 ≤ E lam r u (q 0).1.1 (q 0).1.2 →
      ∀ i, |rho i * Phi z i| ≤ kappa i * M i)
    (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u (q 0).1.1 (q 0).1.2)
    (htheta : ∀ i, |(q 0).2 i| ≤ M i)
    (hq : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
      HasDerivAt q (vectorField lam r u gamma target b kappa rho Phi (q s)) s)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :
    (target ≤ E lam r u (q t).1.1 (q t).1.2 ∧
      E lam r u (q t).1.1 (q t).1.2 ≤ E lam r u (q 0).1.1 (q 0).1.2) ∧
      ∀ i, |(q t).2 i| ≤ M i
records.proof:
by
  refine ⟨energy_band_on_Icc hgamma hT hq hinit ht, fun i => ?_⟩
  exact LinearInputFiniteInternalUpdate.abs_le_on_Icc (hkappa i) (hM i) hT
    (fun s hs => hasDerivAt_internal (hq s hs) i)
    (fun s hs => hforce (q s).1 (energy_band_on_Icc hgamma hT hq hinit hs) i)
    (htheta i) ht
records.comment:
Every finite solution segment stays in its spatial energy band and its
internal coordinate box. Both conclusions follow from the actual ODE.

records.statement:
theorem exists_global_solution {n : ℕ} {lam r u gamma target : ℝ}
    {b : State n → ℝ} {kappa rho : Fin n → ℝ} {Phi : ℝ × ℝ → (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b) (hPhi : ContDiff ℝ 1 Phi)
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma) (hkappa : ∀ i, 0 < kappa i)
    (q₀ : State n) (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u q₀.1.1 q₀.1.2) :
    ∃ M : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ M i) ∧ ∃ q : ℝ → State n, q 0 = q₀ ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        HasDerivAt q (vectorField lam r u gamma target b kappa rho Phi (q t)) t) ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        (target ≤ E lam r u (q t).1.1 (q t).1.2 ∧
          E lam r u (q t).1.1 (q t).1.2 ≤ E lam r u q₀.1.1 q₀.1.2) ∧
        ∀ i, |(q t).2 i| ≤ M i
records.proof:
by
  let K : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {z | target ≤ E lam r u z.1 z.2 ∧
    E lam r u z.1 z.2 ≤ E lam r u q₀.1.1 q₀.1.2}
  have hK : IsCompact K :=
    LinearInputCoercivity.isCompact_band hlam r u target (E lam r u q₀.1.1 q₀.1.2)
  obtain ⟨M, hM, htheta, hforce⟩ :=
    exists_internal_bounds hK hPhi.continuous kappa rho q₀.2 hkappa
  let S : Set (State n) := K ×ˢ Icc (-M) M
  have hS : IsCompact S := hK.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hstart : q₀ ∈ S := by
    exact ⟨⟨hinit, le_rfl⟩, (fun i => (abs_le.mp (htheta i)).1),
      fun i => (abs_le.mp (htheta i)).2⟩
  have hF : ContDiff ℝ 1 (vectorField lam r u gamma target b kappa rho Phi) :=
    contDiff_vectorField hb hPhi lam r u gamma target kappa rho
  obtain ⟨eps, heps, hlocal⟩ := LinearInputCompactLocalExistence.exists_uniform_local_time hF hS
  have hstay : ∀ (a : ℝ) (q : ℝ → State n), q 0 = q₀ →
      (∀ t ∈ Ioo (-eps) a,
        HasDerivAt q (vectorField lam r u gamma target b kappa rho Phi (q t)) t) →
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < a → q t ∈ S := by
    intro a q hq₀ hq t ht hta
    have hi : target ≤ E lam r u (q 0).1.1 (q 0).1.2 := by simpa only [hq₀] using hinit
    have hitheta : ∀ i, |(q 0).2 i| ≤ M i := by simpa only [hq₀] using htheta
    have hiforce : ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ,
        target ≤ E lam r u z.1 z.2 ∧
          E lam r u z.1 z.2 ≤ E lam r u (q 0).1.1 (q 0).1.2 →
        ∀ i, |rho i * Phi z i| ≤ kappa i * M i := by
      simpa only [K, mem_ofPred_eq, hq₀] using hforce
    have hbound := band_box_on_Icc hgamma ht hkappa hM hiforce hi hitheta
      (fun s hs => hq s ⟨by linarith [hs.1], hs.2.trans_lt hta⟩)
      (show t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) t from ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩)
    refine ⟨?_, (fun i => (abs_le.mp (hbound.2 i)).1),
      fun i => (abs_le.mp (hbound.2 i)).2⟩
    simpa only [K, mem_ofPred_eq, hq₀] using hbound.1
  obtain ⟨q, hq₀, hq⟩ :=
    LinearInputGlobalContinuation.exists_forward_solution hF hstart heps hlocal hstay
  refine ⟨M, hM, q, hq₀, hq, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  have hi : target ≤ E lam r u (q 0).1.1 (q 0).1.2 := by simpa only [hq₀] using hinit
  have hitheta : ∀ i, |(q 0).2 i| ≤ M i := by simpa only [hq₀] using htheta
  have hiforce : ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ,
      target ≤ E lam r u z.1 z.2 ∧
        E lam r u z.1 z.2 ≤ E lam r u (q 0).1.1 (q 0).1.2 →
      ∀ i, |rho i * Phi z i| ≤ kappa i * M i := by
    simpa only [K, mem_ofPred_eq, hq₀] using hforce
  have hbound := band_box_on_Icc hgamma ht hkappa hM hiforce hi hitheta
    (fun s hs => hq s hs.1) (show t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) t from ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩)
  simpa only [hq₀] using hbound
records.comment:
Damped internal updates and spatial confinement yield an actual
forward-global coupled solution, with a fixed compact coordinate box.

records.statement:
theorem norm_le_bandRadius {lam r u upper : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) {z : ℝ × ℝ}
    (he : E lam r u z.1 z.2 ≤ upper) : ‖z‖ ≤ bandRadius lam r u upper
records.proof:
by
  let S := max (upper + lowerBoundConstant lam r u) 0
  have hS : 0 ≤ S := le_max_right _ _
  have hmax : upper + lowerBoundConstant lam r u ≤ S := le_max_left _ _
  have hc := coercive_lower_bound hlam r u z.1 z.2
  have hx : z.1 ^ 2 ≤ S := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (z.2 - Real.sqrt 2 * z.1)]
  have hi : 4 * (z.1 ^ 2 + (z.2 - Real.sqrt 2 * z.1) ^ 2 / 2) - z.2 ^ 2 =
      (z.2 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * z.1) ^ 2 := by
    ring_nf
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    ring
  have hy : z.2 ^ 2 ≤ 4 * S := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (z.2 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * z.1)]
  have hR : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt S := by positivity
  have hRsq : (2 * Real.sqrt S) ^ 2 = 4 * S := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hS]
    ring
  change max |z.1| |z.2| ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt S
  apply max_le
  · apply abs_le_of_sq_le_sq _ hR
    rw [hRsq]
    linarith
  · apply abs_le_of_sq_le_sq _ hR
    rwa [hRsq]

records.statement:
theorem exists_radial_target_point {lam r u target : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    {z : ℝ × ℝ} (he : target ≤ E lam r u z.1 z.2) :
    ∃ a : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ a ≤ 1 ∧ E lam r u (a*z.1) (a*z.2) = target ∧
      (1-a) * (target - (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam)) ≤
        E lam r u z.1 z.2 - target
records.proof:
by
  have hz : z.1 ≠ 0 ∨ z.2 ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have hB : 0 ≤ (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) := by positivity
    simp [h.1, h.2, E, f] at he
    linarith
  obtain ⟨a, ha, _⟩ := existsUnique_positive_radius hlam htarget hz
  have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra h
    have hs := energy_outward_strict hlam (lt_of_lt_of_le htarget he) (lt_of_not_ge h)
    rw [ha.2] at hs
    linarith
  have hscale := energy_outward_scaling hlam r u (a*z.1) (a*z.2)
    ((le_div_iff₀ ha.1).2 (by simpa using ha1))
  have hx : (1/a)*(a*z.1) = z.1 := by field_simp [ne_of_gt ha.1]
  have hy : (1/a)*(a*z.2) = z.2 := by field_simp [ne_of_gt ha.1]
  rw [hx, hy, ha.2] at hscale
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale ha.1.le
  have hi : a * (1/a * (target - (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam))) =
      target - (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) := by field_simp [ne_of_gt ha.1]
  rw [hi] at hm
  refine ⟨a, ha.1, ha1, ha.2, ?_⟩
  have hgap := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ha1) (sub_nonneg.mpr he)
  nlinarith
records.comment:
Move inward along the same positive ray to the target level. The displacement
fraction is controlled by the actual energy error, without a root formula.

records.statement:
theorem dist_radial_multiple (z : ℝ × ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    dist z (a*z.1, a*z.2) = |1-a| * ‖z‖
records.proof:
by
  change dist z (a • z) = _
  have hi : z - a • z = (1-a) • z := by rw [sub_smul, one_smul]
  rw [dist_eq_norm, hi, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]

records.statement:
theorem exists_level_point_distance_bound {lam r u target upper : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hlo : target ≤ E lam r u z.1 z.2)
    (hhi : E lam r u z.1 z.2 ≤ upper) :
    ∃ p : ℝ × ℝ, E lam r u p.1 p.2 = target ∧
      dist z p ≤ bandRadius lam r u upper /
        (target - (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam)) * (E lam r u z.1 z.2 - target)
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, ha1, hp, hgap⟩ := exists_radial_target_point hlam htarget hlo
  have hnorm := norm_le_bandRadius hlam hhi
  have hR := bandRadius_nonneg lam r u upper
  have hd : 0 < target - (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) := sub_pos.mpr htarget
  refine ⟨(a*z.1, a*z.2), hp, ?_⟩
  calc
    dist z (a*z.1, a*z.2) = (1-a) * ‖z‖ := by
      rw [dist_radial_multiple, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ha1)]
    _ ≤ (1-a) * bandRadius lam r u upper :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm (sub_nonneg.mpr ha1)
    _ ≤ bandRadius lam r u upper * (E lam r u z.1 z.2 - target) /
        (target - (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam)) := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hd).2
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgap hR
      nlinarith
    _ = _ := by ring
records.comment: An actual point on the target level obeys a computed spatial error bound.

records.statement:
theorem infDist_level_bound {lam r u target upper : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hlo : target ≤ E lam r u z.1 z.2)
    (hhi : E lam r u z.1 z.2 ≤ upper) :
    Metric.infDist z {p : ℝ × ℝ | E lam r u p.1 p.2 = target} ≤
      bandRadius lam r u upper / (target - (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam)) *
        (E lam r u z.1 z.2 - target)
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hdist⟩ := exists_level_point_distance_bound hlam htarget hlo hhi
  have hmem : p ∈ {q : ℝ × ℝ | E lam r u q.1 q.2 = target} := hp
  exact (Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem (x := z) hmem).trans hdist

records.statement:
theorem spatial_error_exponential_of_initial {lam r u gamma target : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    {x y b : ℝ → ℝ} (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u (x 0) (y 0)) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    0 ≤ Metric.infDist (x t, y t) {p : ℝ × ℝ | E lam r u p.1 p.2 = target} ∧
      Metric.infDist (x t, y t) {p : ℝ × ℝ | E lam r u p.1 p.2 = target} ≤
        bandRadius lam r u (E lam r u (x 0) (y 0)) /
          (target - (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam)) *
          (E lam r u (x 0) (y 0) - target) *
          Real.exp (-(gamma * gradientLowerBound lam r u target (E lam r u (x 0) (y 0))) * t)
records.proof:
by
  have hb := energy_band_of_trajectory hgamma htraj hinit t ht
  have hd := infDist_level_bound (z := (x t, y t)) hlam htarget hb.1 hb.2
  have he := energy_error_exponential_of_initial hlam hgamma htarget htraj hinit ht
  have hC : 0 ≤ bandRadius lam r u (E lam r u (x 0) (y 0)) /
      (target - (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam)) :=
    div_nonneg (bandRadius_nonneg _ _ _ _) (sub_nonneg.mpr htarget.le)
  refine ⟨Metric.infDist_nonneg, ?_⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := hd
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he.2 hC
    _ = _ := by ring
records.comment: Exponential approach to the target level as a set in the product metric.

records.statement:
theorem spatial_convergence_of_initial {lam r u gamma target : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 < gamma)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    {x y b : ℝ → ℝ} (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u (x 0) (y 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun t => Metric.infDist (x t, y t)
      {p : ℝ × ℝ | E lam r u p.1 p.2 = target}) atTop (𝓝 0)
records.proof:
by
  let C := bandRadius lam r u (E lam r u (x 0) (y 0)) /
    (target - (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam))
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hE⟩ := energy_convergence_of_initial hlam hgamma htarget htraj hinit
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun t => C * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [sub_self, mul_zero] using (hE.sub_const target).const_mul C
  apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => Metric.infDist_nonneg)) _ hlim
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with t ht
  have hb := energy_band_of_trajectory hgamma.le htraj hinit t ht
  exact infDist_level_bound (z := (x t, y t)) hlam htarget hb.1 hb.2
records.comment:
The spatial distance to the actual nonempty target level tends to zero.
No point limit or periodic limiting trajectory is asserted.
